case: The prose note beside `retention_span` in the registry is rewritten. The field, its type and the comparison are untouched, and this must pass.
why: The adverse case removes the comparison. The benign case is what stops the repair overshooting into a byte comparison of the registry entry: the control is on the CONJUNCT and on the two operands' type, not on the prose beside them. A checker that refused an edited note would make every documentation improvement a contract change, which is how a control stops being read.

patch.value: The retention window this entry holds, as a span in the same unit as the stated outage, so the two can be compared rather than merely recorded beside each other (F6C-11).
